extras: Note content on disk is never modified. A Chinese user guide provides a full walkthrough.
intentEvidence: A language model you configure reads each block and highlights key sentences, key terms, and named concepts directly in the text
motivation: It is built for dense technical notes in Chinese and English, the kind you scan for what the author concluded, what supports it, and which concepts carry the argument.
problem: Scanning dense technical notes for key conclusions, supporting arguments, and core concepts is time-consuming.
summary: AI Reading Highlights uses a configured language model to automatically highlight key sentences, terms, and concepts within notes in both reading view and live preview.
